build_hmtl_predictor: build an HMTL predictor instance with a specified model name for NLP inference
create_instance: create a batch tensor from a tokenized sentence using vocabulary and token indexers
load_model: load an HMTL model with vocabulary and token indexers from a serialization directory
run_predict: run the HMTL predictor on input text to get NER, EMD, relation, and coreference predictions
test_filter_messages: test whether a message should be filtered based on length or emoji-only content
